findings.title: Stale 'last non-blank' comment in _extract_result is a latent trap
findings.detail: The evaluator comment says the reportable result is the 'last non-blank' value, but the loop returns the FIRST non-blank. Immaterial for this template because residue_24hr.mean is a row-constant column aggregate (first == last). Design round-1 NIT #3 already corrected its own prose.
findings.fix: No change needed for TPL-A6B-0002. Implementer note: do not rely on 'last' semantics if the result group ever carries a row-varying field; residue_24hr.mean is safe because it is identical on every row.

findings.title: Weight-stats sheet-quirk expression needs an inline comment to prevent a future 'fix'
findings.detail: sd_* = sd(pool(weights.w_1hr, [mean_1hr])) intentionally reproduces the sheet bug STDEV(F22:F28) that includes the mean cell F28 (verified: 0.155 with mean cell vs 0.219 for the two raw values). Correct and intentional but non-obvious; a maintainer could 'simplify' it and break parity.
findings.fix: Carry a one-line comment on each sd_* field: '# sheet F29=STDEV(F22:F28) includes the mean cell F28 - pool([mean_*]) reproduces it; do not simplify.'
